highlights.title: Amazon says Anthropic’s Claude still OK for AWS customers to use outside defense work
highlights.description: Amazon joined Microsoft and Google in continue to offer Anthropic's Claude AI technology to customers after the Pentagon deemed it a "supply chain risk."

highlights.title: Anthropic launches Claude Marketplace, giving enterprises access to Claude-powered tools from Replit, GitLab, Harvey and more
highlights.description: San Francisco startup Anthropic continues to ship new AI products and services at a blistering pace, despite a messy ongoing dispute with the U.S. Department of War. Today, the company announced Claude Marketplace, a new offering that lets enterprises with an existing Anthropic spend commitment apply part of it toward tools and applications powered by Anthropic's Claude models but made and offered by external partners including GitLab, Harvey, Lovable, Replit, Rogo and Snowflake. highlights.title: Rebellions Eyes Competition With Nvidia, AMD in AI Chips
highlights.description: Rebellions CEO Sunghyun Park discusses how his AI semiconductor startup plans to compete with the likes of Nvidia and AMD in the AI chip space. He speaks with Haslinda Amin from the sidelines of 'IMF Conference; Asia 2050'. (Source: Bloomberg)

highlights.title: Palantir rallies 15% for the week as Iran war boosts prospects, muting Anthropic concern
highlights.description: Palantir's stock had its best week since August and outperformed all of its large-cap tech peers after the U.S. attacked Iran.

highlights.title: Anthropic officially told by DOD that it's a supply chain risk even as Claude used in Iran
highlights.description: The formal declaration will require defense vendors and contractors to certify that they don’t use Anthropic’s models in their work with the Pentagon.

highlights.title: Oracle and OpenAI's Texas Stargate datacenter expansion reportedly on the skids
Anthropic CEO says 'no choice' but to challenge Trump admin's supply chain risk designation in court
highlights.description: Anthropic said even with the designation, the government can't forbid it from working with companies in other capacities.

highlights.title: 5 unresolved questions hanging over the Anthropic–Pentagon fracas: 'It's all very puzzling'
highlights.description: Plenty of unknowns remain after Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth designated Anthropic a "Supply-Chain Risk to National Security" on Friday.

highlights.title: Anthropic bods rework AI damage yardstick, find scant labor impact
Musk’s Spam Frustration Was ‘Confusing’ to Ex-Twitter Executives
highlights.description: Two former top executives at Twitter Inc. sought to beat back Elon Musk’s narrative at a jury trial that they lied to him about the makeup of the platform’s user base when he was purchasing the company in 2022.
